title: What did I change?

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: I can't remember what I just typed in the menu.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Use `git diff` to see what changed in your working folder since the last commit.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: If a file is already staged, use `git diff --staged` to see it.

questions.prompt: What did we add to the menu?

recap: `git diff` shows working folder changes. `git diff --staged` shows what is ready to be committed.

cheatSheet.summary: See changes in the working folder
See changes in the staging area

hints: Try running git diff to see what changed in your working folder.
git diff shows unstaged changes. git diff --staged shows what you have already staged for the next commit.
Run git diff to see the unstaged changes, then run git diff --staged to see the staged ones.
